logging.dispatch-service.config:
Dispatch service application logging configuration. Project: dispatch-service. Approved contract for logging settings.

```json

  "project": "dispatch-service",
  "logging": {
    "level": "debug",
    "format": "text",
    "retention_days": 30,
    "sample_rate": 0.5,
    "redact_user_ids": true
  }
}
```

Field notes: level=debug (not info), format=text (not json), retention_days=30 (integer), sample_rate=0.5 (float), redact_user_ids=true (boolean). Source: approved decision supplied in task trial-55f.
